slots.head: flex items-baseline justify-between gap-items
slots.label: font-body text-ctl-md text-[color:color-mix(in_oklab,var(--text-body-ink-rest,var(--ink-body))_var(--level-ink-body),transparent)]
slots.thumb: absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 start-[calc(var(--arena-slider-at,0)*(100%-var(--sp-5)))] size-5 rounded-pill border-[length:var(--bw-control)] shadow-control-rest cursor-pointer touch-none focus-visible:outline-hidden transition-[box-shadow] duration-[var(--dur-hover)] ease-hover focus-visible:shadow-[0_0_0_var(--bw-focus)_var(--edge-focus)] before:content-[''] before:absolute before:left-1/2 before:top-1/2 before:w-ctl-h-sm before:h-ctl-h-sm before:-translate-x-1/2 before:-translate-y-1/2 border-[color:var(--choices-knob-edge-selected,var(--edge-control))] bg-[color:var(--choices-knob-fill-selected,var(--fill-knob))] text-[color:var(--choices-knob-ink-selected,var(--ink-knob))]

vertical.track: flex-1 self-start h-auto w-ctl-h min-h-[calc(var(--dz-ctl-h)*4)] touch-pan-x
vertical.fill: top-auto bottom-0 translate-y-0 start-0 end-0 mx-auto w-[var(--arena-size-meter,var(--size-md-meter))] h-[calc(var(--arena-slider-to,0)*(100%-var(--sp-5))+var(--sp-5)/2)]
